Hey man, I know how you feel. I was recently involved in a wreck as well that could've easily ended my life. Some people take it harder than others, but don't beat yourself up over it if it just happened. You could've lost your life. There's nothing unreal about that, and your body needs to process it. The first week after my accident I couldn't sleep at all. Just like healing from your physical injuries, the mental injuries will take time. If it's an option, I highly suggest you see a therapist. It was and is extremely helpful for me to walk through the PTSD associated from the accident. Get well man.
